'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Gough LS Kashyyyk (Light) (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Gough]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (Light) (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|OVS16-15-Kashyyyk-remaster.webp|label=Kashyyyk (Light) (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Matthew Gough
* '''Deck name:''' Wookiees Prepare For GLORY!!!...
* '''Username:''' marinemcg
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
